name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns ran and spent $42.10 across 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks, but produced no leads.
points: All activity came from Dedicated night runs, which delivered all 2,300 impressions, all 19 clicks, and a click rate of 0.8% at a spend of $42.10 — with no leads, there is no cost per lead.
Regional Class A — Joliet served no impressions and recorded no clicks or spend, so it had no activity at all on this day.
Month-to-date spend for 2026-11 sits at $42.10, all on Meta, with 28 days still left in the month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort brought in 38 leads: 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 qualified (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort brought in 40 leads: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 qualified (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, and 1 lost — but it is too young to judge its rates yet.
